baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognate pairing تَرْجُفُ / ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ places the r-j-f root in both predicate and named bearer/event.
baseline_models.mechanism: The finite verb folds severe agitation back onto the definite active nominal, presenting an entity or event whose salient action is its own violent oscillation.

activation_trace.role: Severe disturbance supplies both the literal motion and the self-reinforcing predicate-nominal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A day on which an unspecified disturbance occurs.
changed_reading.after: A day marked by the severe self-convulsion of the definite entity or event named al-rajifah.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَوْمَ opens the clause as a temporal accusative, while its branch inventory also lets a day stand for a severe occurrence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The time word can frame more than a calendar container: the event's severity characterizes the day so fully that event and event-time partially coincide.

activation_trace.role: A day used for a severe occurrence turns the temporal frame into part of the calamity's identity.
Severe agitation supplies the occurrence whose intensity saturates the time frame.

changed_reading.before: Yawm merely dates a later quake.
changed_reading.after: Yawm is event-time: the calamitous occurrence is so defining that the day itself is heard as its advent and severity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The r-j-f inventory attached to تَرْجُفُ / ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ includes the spreading of bad or false reports that produces disturbance through speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: Al-rajifah can provisionally name an alarm wave: circulating reports do not just describe disorder but generate collective agitation.

activation_trace.role: Rumor and alarming report provide the literal speech-domain image and the transmission mechanism for social disturbance.

changed_reading.before: The rājifah is only a physically shaking object or event.
changed_reading.after: The rājifah may also be an information shock whose circulation makes a community convulse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus root inventory includes a people becoming ready for war.
baseline_models.mechanism: The definite feminine nominal can be tested as a mobilizing crisis or collective body entering readiness, with agitation reorganized as preparation rather than random motion.

activation_trace.role: War-readiness converts agitation into coordinated mobilization while remaining attached to the focus root.

changed_reading.after: The focus can carry a strange secondary image of a collective or crisis convulsing into organized readiness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies extraction, rapid drawing, free traversal, precedence, and outcome-oriented management. Read as a kinetic buildup, these motions make the rājifah the threshold where controlled movement crosses into system-wide instability.

activation_trace.role: Severe agitation is the focus-state into which the preceding motion sequence is inferred to culminate.
Pulling a thing from its settled place supplies the initial displacement in the buildup.
Rapid drawing or plucking increases the rate of displacement.
Running or swimming supplies sustained movement through a medium.
Advancing and racing add directional acceleration and phase-leading motion.
Managing an affair by looking to its outcome makes the buildup ordered rather than accidental.
The affair or state gives the managed kinetic sequence a common object.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 form a five-member feminine-participle sequence; 79:1-4 intensify motion with cognate nominals, and fa links the later stages before 79:6 opens with yawm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered motion images and their sequence; I supply the causal arrow that treats them as a controlled buildup crossing into r-j-f instability. A live alternative is that the opening agents act in parallel or prepare an affair without mechanically producing the focus event.

changed_reading.before: The rājifah begins as a spontaneous isolated convulsion.
changed_reading.after: The rājifah is the instability threshold reached after a managed sequence of displacement, release, traversal, and precedence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following and coming behind convert the definite rājifah from a complete isolated event into the leading pulse of a two-stage disturbance.

activation_trace.role: Severe agitation supplies the first pulse whose place in a sequence is changed by the next ayah.
Following or treading after establishes a directional relation from a later event back to the focus event.
Something arriving behind another identifies a second, rear-positioned pulse.

structural_cues: 79:7 continues without a new temporal frame, and the object pronoun in تَتْبَعُهَا points back to the feminine rājifah before introducing the feminine rādifah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit following and rear-position images plus pronominal linkage; I infer a sequential two-pulse event rather than mere descriptive apposition. The later feminine nominal could still denote a distinct follower whose exact physical relation is unspecified.

changed_reading.before: The rājifah is the whole convulsive event.
changed_reading.after: The rājifah is the initiating convulsion, defined partly by the second disturbance it sets in train.

context_deltas.mechanism: The severe r-j-f disturbance propagates across scale: the external or collective convulsion is registered as cardiac flutter and then as visibly lowered sight. The event is therefore read through coupled environmental, visceral, and perceptual motion.

activation_trace.role: Severe agitation, whose branch scope includes the heart, permits transfer between outer convulsion and inner bodily response.
The heart supplies the bodily site in which the large disturbance is registered.
Fluttering and palpitation provide the homologous small-scale oscillation.
Eyesight makes the inward disturbance externally legible through gaze.
Lowering and submission convert bodily agitation into a visible posture.

structural_cues: 79:8 places قُلُوبٌ beside the feminine active-participle وَاجِفَةٌ immediately after the feminine ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ / ٱلرَّادِفَةُ sequence; 79:9 then assigns a posture to their eyes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severe agitation, palpitating hearts, and lowered eyes; I supply the propagation arrow from focus-event to body to visible posture. These may instead be consecutive effects without implying shared oscillatory dynamics.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes motion external to human subjects.
changed_reading.after: The focus describes a disturbance whose reality is measured by synchronized inner heartbeat and altered gaze as well as by outer motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single forceful vocal impulse provides a compact trigger model for the severe oscillation: one command is sufficient to drive the system from convulsion into immediate changed state.

activation_trace.role: Severe disturbance is treated as the system response whose input is supplied by the later command image.
A rebuking cry supplies a sharp acoustic or imperative impulse.
Numerical oneness makes the triggering impulse singular rather than cumulative.

structural_cues: 79:13 restricts the transition with إِنَّمَا and وَاحِدَةٌ, and 79:14 follows with an immediate فَإِذَا state change; the branchless surface term in 79:14 is used only as sequence structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one vocal rebuke followed by immediate transition; I infer that this impulse excites or resolves the r-j-f sequence. The cry may instead be a later resurrection command rather than the direct cause of the first convulsion.

changed_reading.before: The rājifah is a self-starting or prolonged quake.
changed_reading.after: The rājifah is a responsive system whose immense transition can be actuated by one decisive command.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering a population, raising a call, and issuing a saying that spreads among people supply a concrete social machine for the focus root's report-induced disturbance and war-readiness branches.

activation_trace.role: Alarm-report disturbance supplies the social transmission mode activated by public proclamation.
War-readiness supplies the collective reorganization that the proclamation can induce.
Driving and collecting a group creates the audience and social body to be disturbed.
A raised call supplies the broadcast channel.
A saying that spreads among people supplies propagation through the assembled collective.

structural_cues: 79:23-24 places gathering, calling, and direct proclamation in an uninterrupted action chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly, broadcast, circulating speech, alarm-report disturbance, and readiness; I infer a political feedback loop in which proclamation convulses and mobilizes the collective. The narrative may instead exemplify arrogance without identifying any social mechanism inside al-rajifah.

changed_reading.before: An alarm wave is diffuse rumor without an identifiable production process.
changed_reading.after: The rājifah can model a staged political information event: assemble, broadcast, circulate, and drive the social body into agitated readiness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Building, raising, evening, solid elevated masses, and anchoring define a stable cosmic architecture. The rājifah becomes the reversal of that architecture: severe oscillation is de-anchoring, with the earth itself carrying a tremor branch.

activation_trace.role: Severe agitation supplies the destabilizing operation applied to the later stability system.
Joining parts into a construction supplies an integrated structure capable of being disrupted.
Elevation supplies one axis of the ordered architecture.
Straightness and completion supply equilibrium and finished order.
The earth's tremor branch supplies a possible oscillating substrate for the otherwise unnamed rājifah.
A high solid mass supplies the architecture's concentrated stability.
Fixity and anchoring define the condition that severe oscillation reverses.

structural_cues: 79:27-32 orders sky-building, raising, evening, earth-placement, and mountain-anchoring as a construction sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a built and anchored order, an earth-tremor branch, and severe focus agitation; I supply the reversal arrow by which r-j-f suspends that order. The construction passage may establish power over creation without specifying the focus event's substrate or mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a generic violent shake with no defined system at stake.
changed_reading.after: The focus is cosmic de-anchoring: the integrated, raised, evened, and fixed order enters its opposite state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Compelled arrival at the main event is followed by recovered memory and exposure. The focus convulsion therefore gains an epistemic function: it shakes concealed or suppressed knowledge into conscious and visible form.

activation_trace.role: Calamitous event-time supplies the frame in which disclosure becomes unavoidable.
Severe agitation supplies the shock that is inferred to dislodge what was hidden or forgotten.
Compulsion and constraint make arrival at the event inescapable.
The main bulk of an affair supplies total event-scale rather than a local disturbance.
Bringing something back after forgetfulness supplies the inward disclosure.
Appearance and uncovering supply the outward disclosure that follows recollection.

structural_cues: 79:34 introduces the overwhelming event, 79:35 returns to a yawm-clause of remembering, and 79:36 passively presents what has been exposed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compelled arrival, event magnitude, recollection, and exposure; I supply the arrow from r-j-f shock to the dislodging of memory and concealment. Recollection and exposure may be consequences of the event without defining its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The rājifah rearranges matter or bodies only.
changed_reading.after: The rājifah is also a disclosure shock, forcing forgotten action into memory and hidden outcome into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus yawm is bracketed by an unanswerable request to anchor the Hour and a retrospective collapse of duration into one evening or morning. Event-time is unmoored prospectively but radically compressed once experienced.

activation_trace.role: An interval of time, rather than only a daylight date, permits event-defined and subjectively compressed duration.
Calamitous occurrence fuses the interval's identity with the event that fills it.
Questioning and seeking supply the attempt to obtain a temporal coordinate.
Fixity and anchorage spatialize the desired but unavailable temporal placement.
The limit at which something ends supplies a terminal boundary without exposing its date.
Remaining in a place supplies experienced duration viewed retrospectively.
Evening supplies one short boundary used to compress the remembered interval.
The span of morning supplies the alternative short boundary for the same compression.

structural_cues: 79:42 asks when the Hour is anchored, 79:44 assigns its endpoint beyond the addressee, and 79:46 closes with a duration comparison between one evening and its morning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a request for temporal anchorage, a withheld endpoint, and retrospective short-duration comparisons; I infer a shift from calendar day to phenomenological event-time. The final compression may concern prior worldly duration rather than the internal duration of the focus yawm itself.

changed_reading.before: Yawm is a datable calendar container for the quake.
changed_reading.after: Yawm is unmoored event-time: impossible to anchor in advance, defined by the convulsion, and retrospectively compressing ordinary duration to an evening or morning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant q-w-l mapping to a branch image of trembling and crosses from speech into mechanics. It remains valid as an activation because the focus r-j-f inventory itself includes report-induced disturbance and the split mapping is explicitly supplied. Render only as an acoustic or social analogy, not as a claim that قَالَ lexically means 'to tremble.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's report-disturbance branch keeps the outlier attached to تَرْجُفُ / ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ rather than turning speech into an independent theme.

activation_trace.role: Report-induced agitation supplies the focus-side bridge between utterance and tremor.
The non-dominant mapped branch of trembling or disturbance turns an utterance into a micro-oscillation within the social field.

changed_reading.before: Speech merely reports or causes a separate disturbance.
changed_reading.after: Each circulating utterance can be modeled as a small tremor composing the larger social rājifah.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Identifying the definite rājifah with the earth is surprising because the focus clause does not name its referent. The reading remains anchored through severe r-j-f agitation and the packet's explicit earth-tremor branch. Downstream prose should call this a possible substrate identification, not a resolved antecedent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The definite active nominal ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ leaves an entity/event slot that the earth's tremor branch can tentatively fill.

activation_trace.role: Severe agitation defines the property required of the unnamed focus bearer.
The earth-as-tremor branch supplies a candidate bearer for that property.

changed_reading.before: Al-rajifah is an unspecified convulsive event.
changed_reading.after: Al-rajifah may be the earth itself considered precisely in its tremoring state.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because a war-readiness branch is distant from the expected physical-event reading. It remains anchored in an explicit focus branch and gains a visible whole-surah mechanism from gathering and calling. Qualify it as a social-mobilization resonance, not as an exclusive identification of the rājifah with Pharaoh's assembly.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The r-j-f war-readiness branch permits the focus's severe agitation to reorganize a collective rather than merely shake matter.

activation_trace.role: Preparing for war supplies the focus-side conversion from agitation to readiness.
Collecting and driving a group supplies the body that can be mobilized.
The raised call supplies the coordinating signal that turns a crowd into a muster.

changed_reading.before: The rājifah is uncoordinated violent motion.
changed_reading.after: The rājifah can resonate as the moment a gathered social body convulses into coordinated readiness.

strongest_changes: The severe self-convulsion becomes the first pulse in a linked two-stage disturbance rather than the complete event.
The focus motion propagates across scale into palpitating hearts and lowered eyes, making bodily response part of the event's mechanism.
The sky-and-earth construction sequence recasts r-j-f as de-anchoring of an integrated, evened, and fixed cosmic order.
The final timing sequence changes yawm from a calendar date into event-time that cannot be anchored beforehand and is compressed in retrospect.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated four different systems around the compact focus clause: a managed kinetic buildup, a social broadcast and mobilization loop, a reversal of cosmic stability, and a disclosure event with unusual temporal behavior. The focus-only report and war-readiness branches remained live instead of being collapsed into the physical reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not resolve the identity of al-rajifah; earth, event, and collective-bearer models remain alternatives.
The causal arrows from the opening motion sequence and the single cry into the focus convulsion are reader-supplied and could instead mark adjacent stages.
The report-disturbance and war-readiness branches are visibly anchored but may operate as cross-domain resonances rather than contextual lexical senses.
The final evening-or-morning compression may measure prior worldly duration rather than the internal duration of the focus event-time.
